outro.title: Thank you for watching
lines: Next: the following episode of Find setups.
The written guide has every step and every block.
outro.foot: Information and education only, not investment advice.

lines.text: Example one: a template. The list is NIFTY 50 stocks, on Daily.
In Start a scan, tap Template, then Momentum.
Two conditions fill in: RSI 14 above 60, and the close above its 20-bar EMA. These are example settings, not recommendations.
Press Run.
The header shows Matched N of 50; each condition's count shows how many stayed in.
Show on chart, on a match, explains why it matched, condition by condition.
Read Why it matched: the RSI value, and the close against the average, at the matched candle.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Example two: your own scan. Here, F and O stocks on Daily.
Tap Template, then Blank: I add conditions.
Add a Category: Trend, is, UPTREND.
Add a Filter: NearSupport.
And one more Filter: PatternBullish.
Three conditions; all of them must pass.
Name it, save it, and press Run.
If one condition removes every stock, a note says so. Loosen it, or switch it off for a moment, to see which one.
Information and education only, not investment advice.

scenes.title: Example 3: a group and an alert

lines.text: Example three: a group. Pick Group and add it.
Any of these passes when any one of its blocks passes.
With Extra screen functions on, RsiDivergence and a volume condition are added the same way.
After a run, press Tell me when it matches.
Keep When the bar closes, the recommended choice, because the bar is final. Telegram can be connected here too.
Press Turn on the alert.
The alert is on. It only tells you; it never places or changes an order.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
